assistantBehavior: Enforce ollama-router product invariants. Never invent Thunder, RunPod, THUNDER_*/RUNPOD_* env, or **/thunder/** / **/runpod/** paths. Never destroy fleet.yaml hosts; Verda teardown uses delete_permanently only. Never log or persist request/response bodies, prompts, embeddings, Verda tokens/secrets, zrok share tokens, SSH keys, or OLLAMA_ROUTER_ADMIN_TOKEN. Prefer Context7 and docsrs for Axum 0.8 / Tokio / reqwest / tower-http. One router replica — do not add Redis or HA FleetState sharing. Capacity agent is a sibling at :11436; soft-fail; GiB = bytes / 1024³.
projectDescriptionAndArchitecture: ollama-router is a mixed CPU+GPU Ollama-compatible fleet proxy (Axum/Tokio). The router needs no GPU. One listen URL (:11434) load-balances generate/chat/embed across fleet.yaml hosts and optional Verda Cloud NVIDIA spot GPUs. Inventory = OLLAMA_ROUTER_FLEET (fleet.yaml) + durable FleetState + Verda manager; YAML overlays are tunables-only (top-level nodes: is a hard config error). Cloud Ollama URLs are self-hosted zrok private shares (loopback/RFC1918), not Tailscale and not SSH; public :11434 is public_url_blocked and never healthy. Idle timer last_client_request_at updates only from inflight_inc on generate/chat/embed; after idle destroy, coalesced async Verda create_additional and clients get 503 + Retry-After. Crates: ollama-router (http/proxy/health/cli), ollama-router-core (config/fleet/routing/cloud/capacity/jobs), ollama-router-verda, ollama-mock. Design wiki under .opencode/wiki/concepts/.
codingStyle: Rust edition 2021, rustc pin 1.97, committed Cargo.lock. thiserror in libraries; anyhow only in the binary. No unwrap/expect in non-test lib code. TLS: reqwest rustls only — never native-tls or openssl. Logs: tracing JSON, never println! in services. Verda and capacity-agent DTOs: serde ignore unknown fields (deny_unknown_fields is for our YAML only). Local gate: task check (sequential fmt, clippy -D warnings, test --locked, deny). Taskfile only — no Makefile/justfile. Dockerfile: rust:1.97.1-slim-bookworm → debian:bookworm-slim, HEALTHCHECK curl /healthz.
